description: Expose a board as a REST endpoint of an app: /apps/{appSlug}/api/{slug}. exposedColumns limits which columns are readable/writable. rowLevelSecurity.enabled makes the endpoint per-user: the developer's server sends `X-App-User: <their user id>` next to the API key, and the endpoint returns, updates and deletes ONLY that user's rows (401 without the header). Use it whenever the app has its own users.

allowedMethods.description: HTTP methods the endpoint accepts: GET, POST, PATCH, DELETE

appId.description: App id or slug (from list_apps / create_app)

exposedColumns.description: Columns the endpoint reads and writes, with the JSON key each one gets; without it the endpoint returns bare metadata

alias.description: JSON key exposed for this column: letters, digits, underscore. Never one of the reserved item fields id, title, description, status, priority, dueDate, assignedTo, createdAt, updatedAt, order, appUserId, a business status column becomes repairStatus or orderStatus, not status.

readOnly.description: Expose the column for reading only; writes to it are refused with 400

organizationId.description: Organization id; defaults to the credential organization when omitted

rowLevelSecurity.description: Row-level security. Off: whoever holds the app key reads everything. On: every request must name a signed-in user, and mode decides which rows they reach

enabled.description: true: every request must carry a signed-in user (the token from sign-in, or the app key with X-App-User)

mode.description: "owner" (default): each user sees and edits only the rows they created. "shared": every user authorized on the app (listed on it, or an owner/admin of the organization) sees and edits every row; the mode for an admin screen or a team system. "phone": a user signed in with a code sent to their phone sees and edits only the rows whose phoneColumn holds that phone, e.g. a directory where each person keeps their own card

phoneColumn.description: mode "phone" only: id of the column that holds each row's phone number (get_board_schema)

slug.description: URL slug: lowercase letters, digits and dashes

name: create_app_endpoint
